newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher on back of firm Dow close.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher on back of firm Dow close.

text.p: UK shares firmed at the outset on Friday, bolstered by a firm Dow close but still jittery ahead of awaiting key interest rate news later in the session.

The FTSE 100 index was up 6.8 points at 4,583.0 by 0740 GMT, after initially rising as high as 4,589.4 -- pushing back towards the 4,600 level surrendered late last month. Decliners were in a 47-35 majority.

Cable & Wireless helped lead the market higher after its Hong Kong unit Hong Kong Telecoms confirmed C&W was in talks with the Chinese authorities on possible co-operation, while Abbey National gained on fresh bid talk.
